end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones places.
Diya worked with 6042 and said “six thousand forty-two” after discussing the zero in the hundreds place.
They explained 2345 correctly as two thousand three hundred forty-five and identified tens and ones in 45.
They remained unsure about writing 8614 in numerals; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value with Diya by separating thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones. Diya correctly worked through 6042 and later corrected the mix-up between 35 and 45 while explaining 2345; the uncertainty about 8614 was still present at the end. At home, practise a few numbers with a place-value table, including zeros in empty places, and have Diya say each digit’s place aloud.
